description: Second send reuses the eventId with a different payload.

expected_upstream.notes: eventId is not in the upstream schema; it is stripped and both requests are stored as separate events.

expected_holocron.notes: First accepted event wins. The later payload is acknowledged as duplicate, not stored, not merged, and increments dedup_conflict (docs/decisions/0002). Answered 200 with the unchanged {cache, sessionId, visitId} body computed as for a stored event; visible only in the duplicate and dedup_conflict counters (docs/decisions/0005, duplicate eventId response; docs/decisions/0002).
